title: Theo and the Garden
author: Gideon Kavanagh
blurb: Freya Sandoval, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
